items.title: At least 102 people are killed and one person is rescued after a series of landslides in the Gamo Zone of Ethiopia.

The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights documents three further reprisal massacres of Alawite minority communities on 12 March in which 158 civilians were killed, totaling 1,383 civilian deaths as a result of fifty separate massacres conducted in western Syria since March 6.
Around 100 people are killed in ethnic clashes and cattle raids in South Sudan.
Nine suicide bombing attacks on the Pakistani military kill more than 350 people in Lahore.
